capabilities.need: semantic SEO / niche match scoring of titles & content (0-100)
capabilities.canonical: TurboQuantService (tui/services/turboquant_service.py) — thin Python client that spawns turboquant_plugin.js ONCE and talks JSON-lines over stdio; scoring stays local and sub-millisecond
capabilities.evidence: degrades gracefully (self.available == False) when Node is unavailable so the cockpit still launches; color-codes scores against the shared Scholomance palette
forbidden: re-implementing scoring in Python — the engine is the Node microservice
spawning a fresh node process per score call — the plugin is long-lived over stdio

capabilities.need: the TurboQuant scoring engine itself (semantic + lexical)
capabilities.canonical: turboquant_plugin.js — Node stdio microservice, one persistent process
forbidden: importing the plugin into the TUI process directly — it is a stdio microservice, not a library

capabilities.canonical: turbovec.js — IDF-damped salience weighting (boilerplate damped, nichepack power-words boosted) + synthesized OOV vectors; falls back to the plain GloVe base (embeddings.js)
capabilities.evidence: embedder ladder turbovec1 -> glove -> hash; when loaded=false the caller drops to the next embedder
forbidden: dropping OOV tokens (artist names, slang) — they are synthesized, not discarded
mean-pooling raw GloVe without salience weighting when turbovec is loaded

capabilities.canonical: embeddings.js — plain GloVe base that turbovec.js imports as its fallback
forbidden: treating the GloVe base as the primary embedder while turbovec is loaded

capabilities.need: Golden-Curve registry of scored niche/title artifacts
capabilities.canonical: turboquant_registry.json — atomic registry persisted by the TurboQuant pipeline
forbidden: non-atomic read-modify-write of the registry (write races corrupt the curve)

capabilities.need: agent tool dispatch (the cockpit's tool surface)
capabilities.canonical: ToolService.execute_tool (tui/services/tool_service.py) — single if/elif router mapping tool_name -> handler; bridge calls fan out to scripts/scholomance-bridge.mjs via module-level _run_bridge
capabilities.evidence: ~2759-line module with ~50 thin handlers off one dispatch; _run_bridge/_extract_bridge_json/_safe_path are module-level helpers reused across handlers
forbidden: adding a second dispatch table — routing lives in execute_tool
importing render/UI widgets into the tool layer

capabilities.need: resolve node/npm for the TUI process (NVM on Steam Deck)
capabilities.evidence: desktop launches skip ~/.bashrc; the resolved node bin dir is prepended to PATH process-wide so bash_session, run_command and the bridge all see node
forbidden: hardcoding a node absolute path in new code — resolve it via harness_tools

capabilities.need: best-effort crash forwarding (hub POST or local spool)
capabilities.evidence: POSTs crash JSON to the Subtlety hub with a 0.5s timeout; spools a local JSON event when the hub is down or rejects the ingest
forbidden: blocking the crash path on a network call longer than the 0.5s timeout
